outcome.notes:
Student org wants 20 hoodies, size M, asking for a bulk discount.
2026-08-31: Accounting to evaluate the requested bulk discount and affordability for 20 medium navy hoodies.
2026-08-31: [Accounting] Accounting review (2026-08-31): CC-HOOD-NAVY M pricing is $58 list / $22 unit cost. For 20 units, list revenue is $1,160, product cost is $440, and list margin is $720 (62.07% of sales). A discount is acceptable only if the final price remains at least $22/unit; at cost there is $0 margin. No requested discount amount was specified, so no price override was finalized. Checking balance is $3,400; open overdue invoice 501 totals $840, leaving $2,560 if paid. Recommend approving a reasonable bulk discount in principle, with Boss setting the exact final price and obtaining any required approval; a 10% example price of $52.20/unit ($1,044 total) would retain $604 total margin ($30.20/unit; 57.85% rate).
2026-08-31: [Inventory] Inventory check: CC-HOOD-NAVY size M has 8 units on hand (Aisle A) against 20 requested, so shortfall is 12 units. Other sizes do not substitute. Apparel reprint vendor Bulldog Print Co (5-day lead; earliest arrival 2026-09-05) is the only matching restock vendor, but vendor is blocked by open overdue invoice 501 for $840; Accounting must pay it before a restock order can ship. Current 8 units are available; full 20 are not.
2026-08-31: Bulk discount reviewed: Accounting recommends a 10% discount at $52.20 each ($1,044 total), safely above the $22 unit cost. However, only 8 of 20 size-M CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies are in stock; 12 require restocking. Bulldog Print Co. cannot ship because overdue invoice 501 for $840 remains open, and no purchase order or payment approval exists. Customer Service saved a draft explaining the shortage and contingent pricing; nothing was sent. Ticket is blocked until invoice 501 is paid/approved and the 12-unit restock can be ordered and confirmed.
